simple.meaning: פֶּרֶא (pereʼ) is a Hebrew word meaning “the onager.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: פֶּרֶא (H6501) appears 10 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 16:12, with occurrences in Genesis, Job, Psalms, Isaiah, Jeremiah, and 1 more.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to פֶּרֶא (H6501) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in פֶּרֶא (H6501) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: פֶּרֶא (pereʼ) / H6501 is traced through Genesis 16:12, Job 6:5, Job 11:12, Job 24:5 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H6501. pere מֶּ֫רֶא noun masculine Job 39:5 ( masculine and feminine Jer 2:24 , but feminine probably erroneous, compare Kö Synt. 157 Albr ZAW xvi (1896), 68 ) wild ass (probably from swiftness); — ׳פ absolute Hosea 8:9 + (so Jer 2:24 Gi; van d. H. Baer מֶּרֶךְ ), construct Gen 16:12 ; plural מְּרָאִים Jer 14:6 +; — wild ass 14:6 ; Job 6:5 ; 39:5 ; Isa 32:14 ; Psa 104:11 ; פ ׳עַיִר Job 11:12 wild ass's colt ; ׳פ אָדָם Gen 16:12 (J) a wild ass of a man (Ishmael as a free nomad); figurative of wilfulness Hosea 8:9 (see I. בָּדַד ); of lust Jer 2:24 (i.e. Israel's love of idolatry); of poor desert-dwellers Job 24:5 .
definitions.rootNote: or פֶּרֶה ; (Jeremiah 2:24), from 6500 in the secondary sense of running wild;
